def count_vowels(text):
    return sum(1 for c in text.lower() if c in 'aeiou')

def reverse_words(text):
    return ' '.join(reversed(text.split()))

def capitalize_words(text):
    return ' '.join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].lower() for w in text.split())

def count_words(text):
    return len(text.split())

def mask_digits(text):
    return ''.join('#' if '0' <= c <= '9' else c for c in text)

def only_digits(text):
    return ''.join(c for c in text if '0' <= c <= '9')

def swap_case_text(text):
    return ''.join(c.lower() if c.isupper() else c.upper() for c in text)

def pair_sum(nums, target):
    return [[nums[i], nums[j]] for i in range(len(nums)) for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)) if nums[i] + nums[j] == target]

def partition_by(nums, pivot):
    return [[x for x in nums if x < pivot], [x for x in nums if x == pivot], [x for x in nums if x > pivot]]

def count_inversions(nums):
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(nums)) for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)) if nums[i] > nums[j])

def remove_value(items, value):
    return [x for x in items if x != value]

def longest_run(items):
    best = cur = 0
    prev = object()
    for x in items:
        cur = cur + 1 if x == prev else 1
        prev = x
        best = max(best, cur)
    return best

def digit_sum(n):
    return sum(int(c) for c in str(abs(n)))

def is_power_of_two(n):
    return n > 0 and n & (n - 1) == 0

def merge_dicts(a, b):
    out = dict(a)
    out.update(b)
    return out

def pick_keys(mapping, keys):
    return {k: mapping[k] for k in keys if k in mapping}

def omit_keys(mapping, keys):
    return {k: v for k, v in mapping.items() if k not in keys}

def sort_records(rows, key, descending):
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r[key], reverse=descending)

def filter_by(rows, key, value):
    return [r for r in rows if r.get(key) == value]

def rename_keys(mapping, renames):
    return {renames.get(k, k): v for k, v in mapping.items()}

def fill_defaults(rows, defaults):
    return [{**defaults, **r} for r in rows]

def pluck(rows, key):
    return [r[key] for r in rows if key in r]

def sum_field(rows, key):
    return sum(r[key] for r in rows if key in r)

def index_by(rows, key):
    return {r[key]: r for r in rows}

def missing_fields(record, required):
    return sorted(k for k in required if record.get(k) is None)
